---
title: "check-duplicate-roxygen.yml"
---

Check for duplicate roxygen parameter documentation across R code files.
The check scans R files to detect duplicated roxygen2 `@param` descriptions
across functions and recommends consolidating them using `@inheritParams`
or `@inheritDotParams`.

Reusing documentation across functions keeps parameter descriptions synchronized
automatically, prevents documentation drift, and improves maintainability.

Files, blocks, or parameters that intentionally duplicate documentation can opt out
by adding a comment directive:

```r
# check-duplicate-roxygen: allow-duplicates
```

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | `'.'` | Target directory or file path to scan. |
| `paths-ignore` | string | `'.git, .github, tests, test, vendor, scratch, _site, node_modules, .pytest_cache, .venv, venv'` | Comma- or newline-separated paths or glob patterns to ignore. |
| `extensions` | string | `'.R, .r'` | Comma- or space-separated list of file extensions to check. |
| `min-desc-length` | string | `'10'` | Minimum character length of parameter description to consider for duplication. |
| `base-ref` | string | `''` | Git ref to diff against for diff-scoped checking (e.g. `origin/main`). On pull requests and pushes, defaults to the PR base ref or previous commit automatically for diff-scoping. |
| `fail` | boolean | `true` | Whether to fail the workflow if duplicate roxygen documentation is detected. |
| `python-version` | string | `'3.x'` | Python version to set up. |

## Permissions

Only `contents: read` (the default), so no `permissions:` block is needed.

## Example

```yaml
name: Check duplicate roxygen
on:
  push: { branches: [main] }
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:
jobs:
  check:
    uses: Morrison-Lab/gha/.github/workflows/check-duplicate-roxygen.yml@v2
```

See the
[`examples/`](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/tree/main/examples)
directory for caller stubs (e.g. `examples/check-duplicate-roxygen.yml`).
